document_completeness.summary: All annual FS files and all read interims contain the full set of primary statements (BS, P&L/OCI, equity, cash flows). The inventory misclassifies them because the statement pages have no text layer: ff6b8311 (full 9M 2025 interim) is 'other_no_statements_found', c063037c (English FY2024 audited FS) 'other_no_statements_found', 71be975f/9043db49 'partial_statements', 4850d417, 5f39f5c8 and b0162b54 (complete Arabic FY2025 and FY2023 FS, KPMG and EY audit reports present) 'scanned_unreadable', eeba86e1 'partial'. Title pages show f69b4f3a (H1 2022) and 02aee213 (Q1 2022) are full interim financial statements labelled 'results_announcement'. PERIOD LABELS: the English annual FS are labelled with the year after the fiscal year: 9043db49 (FY2022) labelled 2023|FY, 71be975f (FY2023) labelled 2024|FY, c063037c (FY2024) labelled 2025|FY, 4850d417 (FY2025) labelled 2026|FY; the Arabic annual FS carry the right label (a9068933 FY2022, b0162b54 FY2023 labelled 2023|FY, 8e1f3ea7 FY2024 labelled 2024|FY, 5f39f5c8 FY2025 labelled 2025|FY). Consequence: slot 2024|FY holds English FY2023 and Arabic FY2024; slot 2025|FY holds English FY2024 and Arabic FY2025; slot 2026|FY holds English FY2025. Interim labels (Q1/H1/9M) matched the cover text in every file checked (14 interim files cover-checked). Q1 2026 cash-flow heading misprints 'nine-month period ended 31 March 2025' although the columns are the three months ended 31 March 2026 and 2025 (issuer typo, values consistent with the BS and the Q1 2025 comparative). Non-statement files: 12 factsheets (one-page), 12 results announcements/press releases, 6 annual reports (91-143 pages, board report plus embedded FS not examined). Duplicates: Arabic and English versions of the same filing (same figures, not independent sources); two identical factsheet families.
